Subject: DPA & TOMs: KMS scope + subprocessor list

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for sending over the initial DPA. A couple of things procurement and security asked us to clarify before we can sign:

- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) for model inference and for long-term embeddings storage? If so, what KMS providers and HSM profiles are supported?
- We need the full current subprocessor list and the rollback/notification process when subprocessors change. Procurement prefers 30 days notice for new subprocessors.
- The TOMs exhibit: we have a couple of requested edits around encryption-at-rest detail and access-control matrix (who in Redwood has plaintext access).

If you can provide a redline of the DPA + TOMs exhibit and an approximate timeline to finalize, procurement will prepare the DocuSign envelope.

Also, do you have a SOC2/pen test date we can reference? Our security team will want the latest report or an attestation.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Markovic
Head of Procurement, NovaPay
elena@novapay.com

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a working redline and the TOMs exhibit draft for your review.

Summary of changes we propose in the attached Redline (Redwood_DPA_redline_v2.pdf):
- KMS: Add option for Customer-Managed Keys (BYOK) for persistent embeddings storage; Redwood-managed KMS remains the default for hosted inference. We list supported providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and a recommended HSM profile for FIPS 140-2 Level 2+.
- Access controls: Expanded TOMs exhibit rows that describe role-based access and a requirement that access to plaintext inference data be restricted to a named security ops group with just-in-time (JIT) privileges.
- Subprocessors: We accept a 30-day notification window for additions, with an exception for emergency replacements (we'll notify as soon as possible). We'll include a public subprocessor page and a contractual commitment to provide a list on request.
- Data transfers: Standard SCCs plus an explicit mention of EU->US transfer safeguards (if applicable).

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_DPA_redline_v2.pdf (PDF, 38KB)], [Attachment: TOMs_Exhibit_draft_v1.docx (DOCX, 56KB)].

Timeline: If you can confirm minor edits to the TOMs exhibit by COB Monday, we can circulate a final redline for legal sign-off by Wednesday and send a DocuSign envelope on Thursday.

SOC2/pen test: Our latest SOC2 Type II is dated 2025-11-20; pen test summary attached in the TOMs doc (redacted). If your security team needs an NDA'ed copy, let me know and I'll route it through Marissa.

Would you like a quick 30-min sync early next week? I can loop in Marissa from legal for any contract points.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Subject: RE: DPA & TOMs: KMS scope + subprocessor list

Stephanie / Elena — copying in legal and AE leadership. Quick notes from Legal on the redline:

- KMS custody: We can offer BYOK for embeddings storage, but we need to preserve the ability to run hosted inference on customer data unless customer explicitly elects to route inference through a private deployment. Proposed compromise: a selectable "Customer-Managed KMS" option in Section 4 with clear operational limitations (e.g., cross-region latency, key rotation responsibilities). I've marked precise language in DPA_redline_legal_v3.pdf.
- Subprocessor notification: Legal prefers 60 days notice for non-critical subprocessors and 10 days for security/ops-critical ones where we need faster replacements. Contractual 30 days is a sales negotiation point — recommend we accept 30 days for general subs and retain internal exceptions for emergency replacements with post-notification.
- Access to plaintext: We need a narrow operational carve-out for incident response (with audit logging). Add a requirement for MFA + privileged access reviews every quarter.
- eSign logistics: confirm which signatory will execute for NovaPay (procurement or legal). Also request procurement to include DocuSign recipient email addresses so we pre-populate the envelope.

Attachment: [Attachment: DPA_redline_legal_v3.pdf (PDF, 12KB)] — legal redlines in tracked changes.

Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
